Class AbstractDAO<T>

Object
AbstractDAO<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The model entity type.
Direct Known Subclasses:
ClientDAO, OrdersDAO, ProductDAO
public abstract class AbstractDAO<T> extends Object
Generic base Data Access Object class implementing CRUD operations via Java Reflection.
